versions.content: Name E2E_ P07Protect State Type Kind Structure Elements Counter Type uint32 Comment Counter to be used for protecting the next Data. The initial value is 0, which means that in the first cycle, Counter is 0. Each time E2E_ P07Protect() is called, it increments the counter up to 0x FF'FF'FF'FF. Description State of the sender for a Data protected with E2E Profile 7. Available via E2E.h
